description: Search and compare hardware wallets (cold wallets for crypto). Use this whenever a user asks which hardware wallet to buy, wants BitBox vs Ledger vs Trezor compared, or asks about a specific maker. Returns structured, sourced records: maker, country, official store, the maker's own description and a link. Pass an empty query to list every maker; a name or keyword to filter.

query.description: Optional filter: maker name or keyword (e.g. 'ledger', 'open source'). Empty returns all.

name: search_hardware_wallets
title: Search hardware wallets (BitBox, Ledger, Trezor)
